title: Constraint Synchronizer: decode sentinels & oscillation regression tests
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add a focused regression test suite that verifies recovery and deterministic behavior when the decoder oscillates between schema-compliant and non-compliant outputs in streaming + tool-calling scenarios. This ticket builds a harness that injects failures and tool-call interleavings, asserts telemetry events (sentinel triggers, decode backoffs), and validates downstream structured-output consumers (function callers, SDK parsers) see either a valid JSON payload or a clearly signaled graceful-degradation path.
background: We have sporadic customer reports and internal CI flakiness where a streamed response begins emitting a valid JSON payload, then an in-flight tool call or a partial token error causes the model to emit additional tokens that break the schema. Existing suites cover many constrained-decoder paths but don't capture the specific 'oscillation' where the model flips compliance state mid-stream and then recovers or falls back. This causes downstream function-call handlers to either crash or silently drop important fields. The goal is to make these behaviors deterministic and observable in CI.
test_plan: 1) Implement a deterministic stream replayer that can inject: token drops, duplicate tokens, delayed tool-call sentinel chunks, and kernel-level backpressure events. 2) Create scenario matrix combining: short/long sequences, nested JSON objects, required vs optional fields, and function/tool call boundaries. 3) For each scenario assert: a) final output is schema-compliant OR b) a well-formed fallback marker is emitted ("__REDWOOD_JSON_FALLBACK") and partial structured data saved to a stable telemetry path. 4) Add flaky-tolerance thresholds: CI must fail only if >3% of runs deviate from expected recovery behavior across 50 runs. 5) Wire events to console rollup dashboard and alert rules for regressions.
acceptance_criteria: - Deterministic harness committed and runnable via ./tools/so-harness/run.sh - Matrix of >=12 scenarios implemented covering streaming+tool-call boundaries - CI job added that runs harness 20x per PR and reports pass rate; failing PRs when the pass rate < 97% - Telemetry emits events: schema_violation_detected, sentinel_fired, constrained_decoder_backoff, fallback_emitted - Runbook created describing mitigation steps and temporary fallback config toggles - Tests validate that SDK-level parser never throws unhandled exceptions when fallback marker is present
scenarios: Interleaved tool call: model emits partial JSON, toolcall sentinel appears, model resumes with extra trailing text that breaks JSON
KV-cache desync: decoder repeats prefix causing duplicate keys and schema validation failure mid-stream
Backpressure pause: streaming pauses then resumes; model emits an array element start without closing bracket
Function-call boundary: nested function return is emitted as raw text then toolcall returns structured payload
Token corruption injection: single-token substitution that changes numeric to string type for required field
steps:
- Build stream-replayer harness and unit tests (Miguel)
- Define canonical schema fixtures (Aisha)
- Implement sentinel detection and fallback marker in runtime shim (Eng Runtime)
- Add CI job and dashboard integration (SRE)
- Run baseline flakiness sweep and iterate on fixes (All)
notes:
- Aim to minimize test flakiness by using seeded RNG and mocked model outputs.
- Add a lightweight deterministic SMT-style validator to check type/required constraints quickly in the harness.
- Consider exposing an opt-in debug flag in hosted API to replay streamed payloads for customer debugging.
- If flaky behavior persists, schedule a canary rollout for constrained-decoder tuning parameters.
